title: A two-sign expectation
statement: Let $a$ and $b$ be independent uniform random signs in $\{-1,1\}$, and define $a\mathbin{\&}b$ to be $-1$ when both signs are $-1$, and $1$ otherwise. Then $\\mathbb{E}[b(a\mathbin{\&}b)]=\frac12$.
